notes: Fixed-supply, fee-free ERC-20: exactly 1e27 units are minted once to the constructor caller, with no owner, administrative functions, mint or burn interface. The Ethereum launch factory distributes the swarm's 10% through its Merkle distributor, seeds the pool from the deployer balance and forwards any remainder to remainderTo. Transfers to and from the PoolManager have ordinary ERC-20 semantics. The declared initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from the economics and deployed currency ordering. Five generated logo approaches are in logos/; artifacts/logo.png selects the original crowned frog mascot.
